faqs.question: What is an AI assistant for real estate agents?
faqs.answer: It is a chat tool such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot that drafts listings, ads, WhatsApp replies and scripts, and summarises brochures and documents. It works like a fast junior colleague: quick first drafts, but it only knows the facts you give it, so every number needs checking.

faqs.question: What is the best AI tool for real estate agents?
faqs.answer: A general AI assistant is the most useful single tool, because it covers listings, ads, captions, scripts and summaries. Choose the one your team will open daily, that handles Hindi and Hinglish, reads PDFs, and has data settings you are comfortable with. Add Canva or CapCut for design and video.

faqs.question: What is the best AI chatbot for real estate?
faqs.answer: The best chatbot for Indian real estate runs on the official WhatsApp Business Platform, answers only from your approved project facts, hands the chat to a named salesperson with the answers so far, connects to your lead forms and saves every conversation to your CRM.

faqs.question: How can real estate agents use ChatGPT?
faqs.answer: Use it to draft property listings, Meta ad copy, first WhatsApp replies, Reel scripts, objection answers and CRM notes, and to summarise brochures. Give it the real project facts, the audience and the limits in the prompt, then check every fact before using the output.

faqs.question: How do I use AI as a real estate agent without risk?
faqs.answer: Use AI for drafts, not facts. Paste in the approved project details, remove buyer names and phone numbers, check every figure against the RERA filing and price list, label AI images as artist's impressions, and keep people in charge of calls, visits and negotiation.

faqs.question: Can AI write real estate ads in India?
faqs.answer: It can write good drafts, but it can invent facts. Under Section 12 of the RERA Act, the promoter is liable for false statements in advertisements, so every AI-written ad must be checked against the approved plans and RERA filing, and must carry the RERA number.

faqs.question: Is it safe to put buyer data into AI tools?
faqs.answer: Only with care. The DPDP Act, 2023 requires personal data to be used for its stated purpose and protected. Remove names, numbers and ID details before pasting, read each tool's data settings, and never upload agreements or ID documents to a personal AI account.

faqs.question: Will AI replace real estate agents?
faqs.answer: No. AI is taking over repetitive work such as first replies, drafts and summaries, not the conversations that decide a sale: understanding the family, the site visit, negotiation and legal steps. Agents who use AI for the routine work gain more time for those conversations.
